evidence.quote: In short, we’re a sports entertainment complex offering an inclusive, high-tech golf game that everyone can enjoy.
Our 1 and 2 bay reservations include 2 hours of game play
Swing by your nearest Topgolf location and discover what makes us an incredible golf experience.
sports complexes where you participate in the sport

draft.notes: Topgolf sells an in-person golf-play experience, not physical goods. Although venues include restaurants and bars, the site identifies the primary business as a sports entertainment complex; the issuer explicitly excludes participating sports complexes from Live Entertainment, so no listed category applies.
